envelope.description: Add groundingMode + capVerdictAtWarn opts to runCodeReview

body.title: Add groundingMode + capVerdictAtWarn opts to runCodeReview
body.summary: In src/workflow/code-review/runner.ts add optional groundingMode?: 'full'|'degraded' (default 'full') and capVerdictAtWarn?: boolean (default false) to RunCodeReviewOpts; thread groundingMode into buildArtifact (stamp body.groundingMode = opts.groundingMode ?? 'full', replacing the hardcoded 'full') and apply capVerdictAtWarn in foldVerdict (when true, promote a folded 'pass' to 'warn'; NEVER lower a block/warn). Both default to today's behaviour so existing callers are byte-identical.
acceptanceChecks: foldVerdict with capVerdictAtWarn:true maps a would-be 'pass' to 'warn' and leaves block/warn unchanged
with neither opt set, buildArtifact stamps 'full' and foldVerdict is unchanged (default parity)

tests.name: runner: runCodeReview with opts.groundingMode:'degraded' -> the persisted record body.groundingMode === 'degraded'
runner: capVerdictAtWarn:true + all-empty findings (would fold pass) -> verdict 'warn'
runner: capVerdictAtWarn:true + a HIGH finding -> verdict stays 'block' (cap never lowers block/warn)
runner: NO groundingMode/cap opts -> body.groundingMode === 'full' and the verdict fold is unchanged (default parity)
